title: The PS2 Train Game That Stops Outside Your House
desc:
A railway timetable was left in my mailbox. Folded inside: an unreleased PS2 signal box game called SIGNALMAN. One rule: clear only the trains on the timetable. Anything else, hold at red. On the second night, a train that isn't on the timetable started waiting at my signal.

An original PS2-era survival horror story from Dead Pixel Studios, the studio that never released a single game. Lost media, a haunted video game, a train that only runs at three minutes past three, and the first name ever found for the person who started Dead Pixel. If you know anything about J. Kell, tell me in the comments.
